origin: Codex 0.142.5: the relay runs out of tokens in the middle of the arguments of a tool call, after some text (finish_reason length). Codex names no output limit, so the limit is the gateway's own default (4096 tokens) which the native accounts are not held to: the answer lost the step it was taking and would end the turn with the text alone, so it is an interruption (a 502 that is not charged, the relay kept from the session) and the client's retry reaches another source. The relay answers are authored from the documented Chat Completions shapes; the expected files are what the gateway does with them.
